facts.fact: Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan opened a joint account at Standard Chartered Bank Uganda to fund a feasibility study for a jointly owned regional communications satellite, with partner-state deposits due by 30 September 2026; the roadmap and budget were reported approved, the study cost and shares were not disclosed, and the study had not started (reported by ChimpReports from a Northern Corridor Integration Projects meeting; the document gives no date for the meeting, so as_of is its published date).

systems.owner: Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan governments
